source_type_distribution: All Clean and Provisional findings classified as "blog" (Medium posts). Zero qualifying findings from source types: reddit, seller_forum, video_transcript, interview. This represents a significant coverage gap. The Gumroad × AI workflow discourse within the time window is heavily concentrated on Medium.
categories_expected_no_findings:
- **reddit:** Despite 19 targeted queries, no Reddit posts found. The intersection of "Gumroad seller + AI production workflow + first-person account" appears extremely rare on Reddit, possibly because Reddit culture discourages self-promotional workflow posts.
- **seller_forum:** No qualifying Indie Hackers or Gumroad community posts within the January 2024–April 2026 window. Gumroad community forum appears inactive.
- **video_transcript:** No YouTube videos found from individual Gumroad sellers describing their own AI production workflow. Generic tutorials dominate this space.
- **interview:** No podcast interviews found with Gumroad sellers about AI production methods.
- **Image-generation AI tools (Midjourney, DALL·E, Stable Diffusion):** No qualifying first-person production workflow descriptions found from Gumroad sellers for any image-generation AI tool. thebudgetpurse uses Midjourney but describes art sales on other platforms. Michael King's Midjourney bot articles likely predate the window.
gumroad_store_verification_gap: None of the 4 findings (Clean or Provisional) include a verifiable Gumroad store URL in the article text. All Gumroad claims are self-reported by the seller in their blog post. Two Part 4 entries (Vell Soren, Kefpreneur) have independently confirmed Gumroad store URLs but failed other criteria.
medium_access_barriers: Medium's 429 rate limiting and member-only paywalls were the single largest obstacle to verification. Multiple promising articles could not be fully accessed or could only be partially recovered from search engine indexing. This systematically depressed the Clean finding count.
yield_vs_expected_shape: Expected ≈10 clean + ≈10 provisional + ≈10 could not verify. Actual: **2 clean + 2 provisional + 19 could not verify.** The shortfall in Clean/Provisional findings reflects: (a) genuine scarcity of detailed, specific, first-person AI production workflow claims from verifiable Gumroad sellers; (b) dominance of the "make money online" Medium content genre, which produces high-volume but low-specificity workflow claims; (c) Medium platform access barriers preventing direct verification; (d) absence of qualifying content on Reddit, Indie Hackers, YouTube, and podcasts within the time window.
inputs_not_searched_without_interpretati: None. All search strategies followed the specified "WHERE TO LOOK FIRST" guidance directly.
